LAW AND MOTION 302, DEFENDANTS SARAH FRYE, ANNA MORRISSEY, TATIANA KARTOMTEN AND JAMES WASHBURN JR.'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT. RULING: ARGUED AND THE COURT ADOPTS ITS TENTATIVE RULING: OVERRULED AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION BASED ON THREE-DAY NOTICE TO PAY OR QUIT BECAUSE PLAINTIFF PROVIDED THE REQUIRED INFORMATION. SUSTAIN WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND CAUSE OF ACTION BASED ON NOTICE TO CURE OR QUIT FOR HABITUAL LATE PAYMENTS, CAUSE OF ACTION BASED ON NOTICE TO CURE OR QUIT FOR TRASH VIOLATIONS AND CAUSE OF ACTION BASED ON NOTICE TO CURE OR QUIT FOR STORAGE VIOLATIONS. THE NOTICES ARE DEFECTIVE BECAUSE THE TEXT OF THE NOTICES FAILS TO SET FORTH THE OPPORTUNITY TO CURE. AS TO CAUSE OF ACTION BASED ON THIRTY DAY NOTICE TO QUIT FOR LATE PAYMENTS, THE DEMURRER IS SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND AS TO WASHBURN WHO IS ENTITLED TO SIXTY DAYS (C.C.P. SECTION 1946.1). OVERRULED AS TO OTHER DEFENDANTS. JUDGE: PATRICK J. MAHONEY, REPORTER: MARIA TORREANO, CSR 8600
